verse.verse_2: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
verse.verse_3: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
verse.verse_4: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
verse.verse_5: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
verse.verse_6: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
verse.verse_7: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
verse.verse_8: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_9: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_10: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
verse.verse_11: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_12: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
verse.verse_13: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
verse.verse_14: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
verse.verse_15: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
verse.verse_16: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_17: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
verse.verse_18: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
verse.verse_19: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
verse.verse_20: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
verse.verse_21: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
verse.verse_22: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
verse.verse_23: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
verse.verse_24: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
verse.verse_25: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
verse.verse_26: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
verse.verse_27: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
verse.verse_28: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
verse.verse_29: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
verse.verse_30: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
verse.verse_31: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
verse.verse_32: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
verse.verse_33: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
verse.verse_34: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
verse.verse_35: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
verse.verse_36: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
verse.verse_37: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
verse.verse_38: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
verse.verse_39: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
verse.verse_40: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
verse.verse_41: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
verse.verse_42: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).
verse.verse_43: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!
verse.verse_44: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.
verse.verse_45: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.
verse.verse_46: And the wizards were flung prostrate,
verse.verse_47: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_48: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
verse.verse_49: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
verse.verse_50: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
verse.verse_51: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
verse.verse_52: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.
verse.verse_53: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,
verse.verse_54: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,
verse.verse_55: And lo! they are offenders against us.
verse.verse_56: And lo! we are a ready host.
verse.verse_57: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
verse.verse_58: And treasures and a fair estate.
verse.verse_59: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
verse.verse_60: And they overtook them at sunrise.
verse.verse_61: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
verse.verse_62: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
verse.verse_63: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
verse.verse_64: Then brought We near the others to that place.
verse.verse_65: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
verse.verse_67: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_68: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_69: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
verse.verse_70: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
verse.verse_71: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
verse.verse_72: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
verse.verse_73: Or do they benefit or harm you?
verse.verse_74: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
verse.verse_75: He said: See now that which ye worship,
verse.verse_77: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_78: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
verse.verse_79: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
verse.verse_80: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
verse.verse_81: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
verse.verse_82: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
verse.verse_83: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
verse.verse_84: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
verse.verse_85: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
verse.verse_86: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
verse.verse_87: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
verse.verse_88: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
verse.verse_89: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
verse.verse_90: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
verse.verse_91: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
verse.verse_92: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
verse.verse_93: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?
verse.verse_94: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
verse.verse_95: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
verse.verse_96: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
verse.verse_97: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
verse.verse_98: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_99: It was but the guilty who misled us.
verse.verse_102: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
verse.verse_103: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
verse.verse_104: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_105: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
verse.verse_106: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_107: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verse.verse_108: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verse.verse_109: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_110: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verse.verse_111: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
verse.verse_112: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
verse.verse_113: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;
verse.verse_114: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
verse.verse_115: I am only a plain warner.
verse.verse_116: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
verse.verse_117: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
verse.verse_118: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
verse.verse_119: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verse.verse_120: Then afterward We drowned the others.
verse.verse_121: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_122: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_123: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
verse.verse_124: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_125: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verse.verse_126: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verse.verse_127: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_128: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?
verse.verse_129: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?
verse.verse_130: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?
verse.verse_131: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verse.verse_132: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
verse.verse_133: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
verse.verse_135: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
verse.verse_136: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
verse.verse_137: This is but a fable of the men of old,
verse.verse_138: And we shall not be doomed.
verse.verse_139: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_140: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_141: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
verse.verse_142: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_143: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verse.verse_144: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verse.verse_145: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_146: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
verse.verse_148: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,
verse.verse_149: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?
verse.verse_150: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,
verse.verse_151: And obey not the command of the prodigal,
verse.verse_152: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
verse.verse_153: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
verse.verse_154: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.
verse.verse_155: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
verse.verse_156: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.
verse.verse_157: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.
verse.verse_158: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_159: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_160: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
verse.verse_161: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_162: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verse.verse_163: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verse.verse_164: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_165: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,
verse.verse_166: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
verse.verse_167: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
verse.verse_168: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
verse.verse_169: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
verse.verse_170: So We saved him and his household, every one,
verse.verse_171: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
verse.verse_172: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
verse.verse_173: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
verse.verse_174: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_175: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_176: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
verse.verse_177: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_178: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verse.verse_179: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verse.verse_180: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_181: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
verse.verse_182: And weigh with the true balance.
verse.verse_183: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
verse.verse_184: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
verse.verse_185: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
verse.verse_186: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
verse.verse_187: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
verse.verse_188: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
verse.verse_189: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
verse.verse_190: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
verse.verse_191: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_192: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_193: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
verse.verse_194: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
verse.verse_196: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
verse.verse_197: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
verse.verse_198: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
verse.verse_199: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
verse.verse_200: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
verse.verse_201: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
verse.verse_202: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
verse.verse_203: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
verse.verse_204: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
verse.verse_205: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
verse.verse_206: And then cometh that which they were promised,
verse.verse_207: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
verse.verse_208: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
verse.verse_209: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
verse.verse_210: The devils did not bring it down.
verse.verse_211: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
verse.verse_212: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
verse.verse_213: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
verse.verse_214: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
verse.verse_215: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
verse.verse_216: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
verse.verse_217: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_218: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
verse.verse_219: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
verse.verse_220: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
verse.verse_221: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verse.verse_222: They descend on every sinful, false one.
verse.verse_223: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
verse.verse_224: As for poets, the erring follow them.
verse.verse_225: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
verse.verse_226: And how they say that which they do not?
verse.verse_227: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
